receipt.equivalence_review: CORRECT_REFUSAL: Replayed six successful queries and the actual registry-search error exactly. Full block enumeration and inspected sink-only contracts establish the missing three-phase function. The unsupported query is not absence evidence; original bytes and hashes match.

refusal.reason: N6 requires three independently commanded half-bridges, six host gate commands, three distinct winding terminals and a floating inactive phase for a star-connected BLDC motor at 0.50 A and 10 kHz. The complete broker block search was inspected for every block category and exported port; it provides no motor.three-phase-bldc or independently controlled half-bridge contract. Actual show contracts for block:g2-low-side-switch and block:g2-relay-channels establish why the available switching candidates cannot substitute: g2-low-side-switch exposes only GATE and POWER_SINK RETURN, with Q1.pin:2 tied to GND, Q1.pin:3 tied to RETURN, and VLOAD connected to the clamp diode, not a commanded high-side switch; its fixed output_current is 0.1 A. g2-relay-channels exposes GATE1/GATE2 and POWER_SINK RETURN1/RETURN2, ties the ULN2003A emitter and unused inputs to ground, and exposes no controllable high-side source. Its fixed per-channel output_current is 0.1 A and its thermal check assumes a 10 Hz external coil switching rate. Replicating these sink-only contracts cannot supply the required independently selectable source/sink/floating phase functions. This is an unavailable topology/function selection, not a claim that a suitable real-world BLDC design is impossible. No brushed, stepper, or invented replacement graph is submitted.
